cbv30:1.1: May those powerful gods and nāgas stationed in the sky or on the earth,
cbv30:1.2: having shared in this merit protect the teaching for a long time!
cbv30:2.1: May those powerful gods and nāgas stationed in the sky or on the earth,
cbv30:2.2: having shared in this merit protect the preaching for a long time!
cbv30:3.1: May those powerful gods and nāgas stationed in the sky or on the earth,
cbv30:3.2: having shared in this merit protect me and others for a long time!
cbv30:4.1: May this (merit) go to my relatives, may my relatives be happy!
cbv30:5.1: May this (merit) go to my relatives, may my relatives be happy!
cbv30:6.1: May this (merit) go to my relatives, may my relatives be happy!
cbv30:7.1: May the sky-god rain down in due season, and (may there be) the right conditions for all good fortune,
cbv30:7.2: may the world be prosperous, may the king always be righteous.
